PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme for Post-Meniscus Recovery"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Strength build with knee-friendly loading for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Protection" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Gait & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          db_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band_external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Gait & Core Stability Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength Development" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower-Body Strength, knee-friendly":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          sumo_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
          calf_stretch 1 minute
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower-Body Strength Progression":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x5..7 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1 minute
          glute_stretch 1 minute
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Peak Strength & Ski Return Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Power & Load Management (low impact)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 2 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Ski-Specific Strength & Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dutch_hw_? (not allowed) - replace with step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x30s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute
          back_stretch 1 minute

Notes:
- Ensure no jumping or deep knee flexion under load is prescribed. If an exercise risks knee joint compression, substitute with a safe alternative (e.g., leg press instead of deep squats if advised; or step-ups with higher stance and controlled tempo).
- All exercises use canonical names from the allowed vocabulary.
- Warmups/cooldowns use allowed cardio modalities; keep intensity low to moderate.
- RPE targets are guidance; adjust if pain or swelling occurs.
- Progression: increase load conservatively by ~2.5–5% when a given set/reps pattern completes with comfortable RPE.

END PLAN
